facts.fact: The guide estimates Google Ads (Search) for camps at $800-$2,500 per month during the decision window, throttled to near-zero off-season.
facts.quote: Expect $800-$2,500/month during the window, throttled to near-zero off-season.

facts.fact: The guide estimates Meta and Instagram ad budgets for camps at $400-$1,200 per month in season.
The guide suggests running streaming TV (CTV) January through April in draw-radius zips at $500-$1,500 per month.
facts.quote: Run it January through April at modest frequency in your draw-radius zips ($500-$1,500/month)

facts.fact: The page claims consumers trust TV ads at roughly twice the rate of social ads, a figure given without a cited source.
facts.unit: times the trust rate of social ads
facts.quote: consumers trust TV ads at roughly twice the rate of social ads

facts.fact: The page states that email and early re-enrollment for established camp programs routinely yields 30-60% of capacity.
facts.quote: Yield: routinely 30-60% of capacity for established programs.

facts.fact: The page gives an illustrative referral structure of $50 off for both families when a family refers a friend.
facts.quote: a simple "$50 off for both families" structure

facts.fact: The guide notes that most summer camp enrollment decisions happen between January and May.
facts.quote: most summer enrollment decisions happen between January and May

facts.fact: The guide describes the summer camp enrollment calendar as browsing starting in January, serious decisions February through April, and late fills in May and June.
facts.quote: browsing starts in January, serious decisions run February through April, and late fills happen in May and June.

facts.fact: The guide recommends a priority-enrollment window for returning families in December or January, before public registration opens.
facts.quote: A priority-enrollment window for returning families in December or January (before public registration opens)

facts.fact: The guide's sample plan for a camp spending $12,000 a year on advertising allocates 25% to December-January, 55% to February-April, 15% to May-June, and 5% to July-August.
facts.quote: A practical season for a camp spending $12,000 a year on advertising:

facts.quote: This guide compares the seven advertising channels that fill camp sessions and youth program rosters in 2026

facts.fact: Adwave advises summer camps to start advertising in January, with re-enrollment for past families opening even earlier in December.
facts.quote: January, with re-enrollment for past families opening even earlier in December.

facts.fact: Adwave says parent browsing for camps begins right after the holidays and serious enrollment decisions run February through April.
facts.quote: Parent browsing begins right after the holidays, serious decisions run February through April

facts.fact: Adwave states that streaming TV has CPMs of $15-35.

facts.fact: Adwave says ad creation on its platform is free.
